name: 68064 · Valley, NE
findings: ZIP 68064 (Valley) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68064 (Valley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
